//boards: ONE BOARD IS THE ORDINARY CASE AND NEEDS NOTHING HERE. A repository drawing two products declares each board's own documents under `boards` and keeps the rest shared: "boards": { "console": { "parityList": "_plans/console/SCREEN-PARITY.md", "handoverFile": "_plans/console/WALK-NOTES.md" }, "workbench": { … } }. `parityList` and `handoverFile` must be each board's own — a walk writes what is left into the list it was given, and two boards sharing one list leave a reader unable to say which product a remaining frame belongs to. Every walk names its board before it starts.
